item.title: Cuomo says rivals urged companies to opt out of OKXICE tokenized stocks
item.description: Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo said competitors encouraged companies to opt out of OKXICE’s rollout, while some issuers simply wanted more time.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Bitcoin rebounds 17% from $55K lows as Nvidia rally sparks $500M crypto liquidations
item.description: Bitcoin price upside hit $64,500 as risk assets surged on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s reinstatement, while crypto liquidations topped $500 million four hours.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Cross River Bank enters Bitcoin-backed lending with $250K loans
item.description: The US bank is offering Bitcoin-backed loans ranging from $10,000 to $250,000 through LendingUSA, allowing borrowers to access cash without selling their holdings.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: How market depth shapes the price of a weekend Bitcoin sale
item.description: Over 14 hours, Bitcoin traded on Kraken’s Canadian dollar market at an average 37.3% discount to a benchmark based on the exchange’s US dollar trades.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Adrian Zmudzinski

item.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO amid ongoing intelligence probe
item.description: Nvidia shares surged nearly 29% after the company’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following consultations with the US government.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: OKX, ICE launch 113 tokenized assets despite issuer objections
item.description: The venture named Coinbase and Fidelity among the issuers and asset managers in the rollout after 67 companies objected to having their shares traded on the venue.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin secures $150M credit line from FalconX
item.description: The miner can borrow against its Bitcoin to fund operations and expansion after selling about 465 BTC to cover expenses in the third quarter.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Strategy buys 457 Bitcoin, spends $212M on preferred share buybacks
item.description: Strategy raised its preferred stock buyback limit to $4 billion and authorized the transfer of up to $1 billion from its dollar reserve.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: AI agents are using credit cards. Where does that leave crypto?
item.description: AI agents are already using credit cards to transact, raising questions about where crypto fits in the emerging agent economy.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Critics of Netflix’s FTX drama point to Obama’s producer credit
item.description: Series creator Graham Moore said he invented a scene in which Changpeng Zhao urges Alameda Research to trade ahead of FTX customers’ orders.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: ECB to let banks pledge more tokenized securities as collateral
item.description: The ECB aims to start accepting securities issued on platforms licensed under the EU’s distributed ledger pilot program in June 2027.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: BTC price gains 12% from $55K: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
item.description: Nasdaq-100 futures rose 3.1% before Monday’s open, while Wednesday’s US inflation report could shape expectations for a December rate hike.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: ‘MoldyRoost’ ads can steal crypto wallet recovery phrases from iPhones
item.description: The campaign used at least 480 ad domains to target users in more than 47 countries and could infect a vulnerable iPhone with a single tap.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $1.8B in third-largest weekly outflow
item.description: Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $4.14 billion in November through Friday, nearing June’s $4.51 billion total.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Trump renews call for Nvidia to rehire Jensen Huang as CEO
item.description: In a Truth Social post on Monday, Trump said rehiring Jensen Huang would benefit both Nvidia and the US.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Billionaire Bill Ackman warns Fed will make a rate ‘mistake’ in December
item.description: Markets and economists widely expect the US Federal Reserve to raise interest rates by 25 basis points in its December meeting.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Half of wallets on Trump’s dinner list got tokens from non-US exchanges
item.description: Public Citizen traced 66 of 130 qualifying wallets to exchanges that restrict US users, raising questions over who is attending Trump’s memecoin dinner on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Will Bitcoin’s big rebound hold? More tampered Ledgers found: Hodler’s Digest
item.description: Bitcoin rebounds sharply from its new cycle low, but is $55,111 really the bottom? Ledger investigates new reports of tampered devices in Berlin and the UAE.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: The future of onchain FX could start with users, not institutional liquidity
item.description: Onchain FX does not need to recreate the trillion-dollar institutional market to become useful. Real demand can make smaller markets work first.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Egorov

item.title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17K on Kraken, exchange upholds trades
item.description: Kraken said all orders were processed correctly and found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
item.description: Cyber reported unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana, followed by tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, prompting an investigation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
item.description: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23, promising to treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw law enforcement complaints.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
item.description: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
item.description: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Hong Kong pushes to bring crypto custodians, advisers under licensing rules
item.description: Hong Kong’s securities regulator says the proposal would strengthen investor protections, with the bill set for its first reading in the Legislative Council on Dec. 2.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Wrapped Monero token crashes 99.8% amid suspected $13.5M exploit
item.description: Bitquery traced $13.5 million in suspicious sales of the wrapped Monero token, as its operator blamed a security breach and promised to reimburse affected traders.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
item.description: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff
item.description: Bitcoin fell nearly 6% as US stocks declined, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 2% and Anthropic shares losing almost 10%.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
item.description: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar
